description: qou-pdix route 5 / qou-cds1 branch 3: a holonomy whose generator has REAL spectrum has normalised character cosh(a) >= 1 for every real a, while the measured correction is strictly below 1 (Q_beta/Q_A = 0.998325; ladder cosine factor 0.998399 under C, 0.998999 under D). The Kohno-Drinfeld scale-fixing hbar = 2 ln q makes the generator real at the substrate's real q0 > 1, giving character (q + 1/q)/2 = 1.005448 -- excess (q-1)^2/(2q), a square, so never negative. WRONG SIDE of 1, by 0.706 %. Because the bound is quantified over ALL real a, this is INDEPENDENT of the residues and so closes all three survivors PhaseFailsLogFunctionalEquation left open (q-dependent residues, non-flat, q-dependent-parameter). What route 5 needs is an ELLIPTIC generator (det A > 0) at real q, which points at conj:im-q-physical-role. Also a new tier-0 discriminator for qou-pdix's D1-D6 test, read from the construction like D5/D6. Lean: QOU/QBeta/HolonomySpectrumSignObstruction.lean, 6 theorems, sorry-free.

assertions.name: kd_character_is_at_least_one_and_is_a_square_excess
assertions.detail: (q + 1/q)/2 = 1.0054484333536; excess over 1 equals (q-1)^2/(2q) = 0.005448433354 exactly — a square over a positive, so never negative (Lean kd_character_sub_one)

assertions.name: kd_holonomy_is_on_the_wrong_side_of_one
assertions.detail: KD gives 1.00544843335, the data needs 0.998398945253 — not merely off by 0.70608 %, but on the wrong side

assertions.name: no_real_generator_eigenvalue_reaches_the_target
assertions.detail: cosh(a) >= 1 > required for every real a sampled, and the minimum over all real a is exactly 1 at a = 0 — so the exclusion is INDEPENDENT of the residues, which only change which a appears

assertions.name: elliptic_generator_is_required_not_optional
assertions.detail: an elliptic generator (det A > 0, spectrum +-i*0.056594738) reproduces the character; Kohno-Drinfeld gives det A = -0.010886986 < 0, hyperbolic

assertions.name: strengthens_the_constant_residue_exclusion
assertions.detail: PhaseFailsLogFunctionalEquation excluded c*ln q (constant residues) by a functional equation; this excludes every real-spectrum generator including q-dependent and non-flat ones, by a sign

context.axis: qou-cds1 branch 3 / qou-pdix route 5: can a KZ holonomy give the phase?
context.answer: Not with a real-spectrum generator, whatever its residues. The character is cosh(a) >= 1 for every real a and the data needs < 1. Kohno-Drinfeld's own scale-fixing hbar = 2 ln q makes the generator real at the substrate's real q, so the reading the corpus cites is on the wrong side of 1. Route 5 now needs an ELLIPTIC generator at real q -- the imaginarity has to come from somewhere, and conj:im-q-physical-role is the corpus's name for that place.
context.strengthens: PhaseFailsLogFunctionalEquation, which excluded only CONSTANT-residue holonomies (c*ln q, by the doubling identity). This closes the three survivors that bean names -- q-dependent residues, non-flat, q-dependent-parameter -- because the inequality is quantified over all real a and never reads the residues.
context.scope: Scope-(b). Does not show no connection exists, does not derive alpha, does not adjudicate a convention, wires nothing. It shows the elliptic requirement is not optional.
